study: Confirmation indicators on the desk's own opens: do ADX trend strength, OBV / accumulation-distribution confirmation, or the pasted article's four-way confluence pick desk arms (arm_ok True) that beat the same name's random later minute by more than the arms they exclude, after costs? The operator's 10/8 video setups S2-S7 are counted as information only.
registered_at: 2026-10-21, before any script, feature or outcome
origin: Operator 10/21 pasted a generic 'top indicators for entering a position' list and asked whether all of it was tested on our opens. Audit the same day (study docs + memory): trend MAs, RSI, MACD, RS vs SPY, RVOL, VWAP, Bollinger, ATR stops, S/R, regime, catalysts and earlier confluence scores are all tested and failed or are underpowered. Not tested: ADX (signals.adx exists but the engine never publishes it, DESK_ROADMAP P2-1), OBV and accumulation/distribution (no study), the article's exact confluence example, and the 10/8 video setups on the desk's population (structure_pullback_prereg.json is a history-universe study; its S2 count step ran 10/9, projected MDE 22 bp > 15 bp, the pre-committed extension to 2025-11-03 was never run and nothing was scored).
prior: LOW. Entry setups are noise-equivalent (entry-setups-are-noise-equivalent); %R crosses, RSI/MACD events, S/R, VWAP, market tide, intraday RS and the squeeze release all matched a random minute (INDICATOR_LEVELS_2026-10-02); the combined score failed out of period (combined-score-positive-held-out); the Grok RVOL/VWAP/EMA-pullback/RSI7 confluence netted -36.5 bp; multi-timeframe EMA agreement had no survivor (edge2_mtf). Volume-derived features (OBV, A/D) are feed-sensitive (volume-ratios-need-one-feed), so features are computed on IEX first.

population.sessions: the cached days of ai_reports/early_entry_honest/ on the mini, 2026-09-08 .. 2026-10-20 (31 sessions; 2026-09-05 excluded as partial). Day exclusion has two rules, both applied and both listed: (a) load_days' own rule (a day is excluded when IEX or SIP board-name bar misses exceed 5%); (b) a day where > 5% of ARM name-days lack IEX or SIP bars in 09:30 .. 16:00.
population.arms: rows in ai_reports/decision_ledger/<day>.jsonl with stage 'arm' AND arm_ok is True, ET minute m in 10:00-15:30, SIP close of minute m-1 >= $10. Deduplicated to one per name per 15 minutes using True rows only (the first True row; a refused row never blocks a later True one). Rows with arm_ok False or None (refusals, 'tape_only') are NOT arms: decision_ledger.row_from_shadow labels every shadow sample with a verdict as stage 'arm'. Read-only count 10/21 before the $10 filter: 354 True arms in half A, 651 in half B (vs 3,091 / 5,774 all arm rows).
population.all_arm_rows_information: all stage-'arm' rows regardless of arm_ok, deduplicated the same way, scored identically and labelled separately; cannot pass.
population.fills_information: paper-account BUY fills over the same days from the outcomes / positions record (as desk_fills does), never the trade log (trade-log-is-submissions-not-fills); information only.

features.bars: PRIMARY: IEX 1-minute RTH bars from the cache (the live feed). SECONDARY (information): the same features on SIP bars. Bars 04:00-09:29 are dropped; every feature restarts at 09:30 each day. Only bars COMPLETED before the arm minute m are used (09:30 .. m-1); entry is at m+1 (look-ahead checked clean by the skeptic 10/21). A missing IEX minute is carried as no bar (no fill); a feature whose window has < 80% of its bars present is None and the arm is excluded from that cell (counted).
features.ADX: Wilder ADX(14) with +DI(14) / -DI(14) on 1-minute bars from 09:30 (Wilder smoothing alpha 1/14; TR, +DM, -DM seeded by the simple sum of the first 14 values, ADX seeded by the simple mean of the first 14 DX values; ADX valid after 28 bars).
features.OBV: on-balance volume cumulated from 09:30 (sign of close-to-close change x bar volume; unchanged close adds 0).
features.AD: accumulation/distribution line cumulated from 09:30: ((close - low) - (high - close)) / (high - low) x volume; a bar with high = low adds 0.
features.confirmation: a line L (OBV or AD) CONFIRMS at m when the close of bar m-1 is >= the max close of bars m-30 .. m-2 (price at a 30-minute high) AND L at m-1 >= the max of L over m-30 .. m-2. It DIVERGES when price is at the 30-minute high and L at m-1 is below that max. Arms with price not at a 30-minute high are NOT_AT_HIGH (neither group).
features.C1_article_confluence: graded only on arms with m >= 10:31. EMA(n) on 1-minute closes from 09:30, alpha 2/(n+1), seeded by the SMA of the first n closes. RSI(14) Wilder, seeded by the simple mean of the first 14 gains and losses. VWAP = cumulative (high+low+close)/3 x volume / cumulative volume from 09:30. All four legs: (i) trend up = close(m-1) > EMA50(m-1) AND EMA50(m-1) > EMA50(m-11); (ii) pullback holding support = for at least one level X in {EMA20, VWAP}, read per bar (X(k) at each bar k): the lowest low of bars m-15 .. m-1 is within +/-0.3% of X at that low's bar, AND no close of bars m-15 .. m-1 is below X(k) x 0.997; (iii) RSI turning up from ~45 = min RSI over m-10 .. m-2 in [38, 52] AND RSI(m-1) > RSI(m-2); (iv) volume expanding = volume(m-1) > mean volume of m-6 .. m-2.

control: the harness control (early_entry_honest.control_minute): one minute drawn uniformly from the RTH minutes m+1 .. m+60 of the same name-day that have bars (NOT restricted to board minutes: staying on the board depends on the price path), seed int(sha256(f'{symbol}|{day}|{m}|indicator-confirm-v1').hexdigest()[:16], 16). One control per arm, shared by every cell. No legal minute -> the arm is dropped (counted). Same net10 and cost.
outcome: net10 = SIP close of minute m+10 / SIP open of minute m+1 - 1 - 0.10% (early_entry_honest.markout; exit bar capped at 15:59). The 10 bp round trip is the harness convention, conservative against the measured ~3 bp spread; it only bites the 'IN net > 0' condition. The 10-minute hold is the harness convention and sits at the top of the book standard's 3-8 minute holds; a 5-minute hold is reported as information.

hypotheses.H1_adx_trend: IN = arms with ADX >= 25 and +DI > -DI. OUT = all other arms with a valid ADX.
hypotheses.H2_adx_chop: a REFUSAL claim: IN = arms with ADX >= 20 (kept); OUT = arms with ADX < 20 (the chop the article says to skip). Graded on the difference-in-differences, and OUT's own lift_vs_random must be < 0 (refusing chop removes losers, not just noise).
hypotheses.H3_obv_confirm: IN = arms where OBV CONFIRMS; OUT = arms where OBV DIVERGES.
hypotheses.H4_ad_confirm: IN = arms where AD CONFIRMS; OUT = arms where AD DIVERGES.
hypotheses.H5_confluence: IN = arms (m >= 10:31) with C1 true; OUT = arms (m >= 10:31) with C1 false.

statistic: Per arm: d = net10(arm) - net10(its control). Per cell and day: lift_vs_random = mean d over IN arms; DiD = mean d over IN - mean d over OUT (days with >= 3 arms each side). Day-equal means, day-clustered t (df = days - 1). Name-day-equal versions are reported and required (below). DiD replaces a raw IN-minus-OUT mean, which would pick up clock-time and name differences.
multiplicity: One family, H1-H5: Bonferroni 5, one-sided p = 0.005; t_crit from a t distribution at the half's df = days - 1 (half A df 12: t_crit ~ 3.05; half B df 17: ~ 2.90), computed by the script from the actual day count. H1 is a subset of H2's IN and H3/H4 are correlated, so Bonferroni is conservative. Video setups are information only and carry no correction.
power: OUTCOME-BLIND COUNT STEP before any outcome is read: per cell and half, IN arms, OUT arms, IN name-days, and days with >= 3 arms each side; projected SE = sqrt(2) x the day-clustered SE of the CONTROL arms' net10 for the IN arms of that half (no arm outcome read); projected MDE = (t_crit + 0.84) x projected SE. A cell with < 100 IN arms, < 100 OUT arms or < 8 days per half is UNDERPOWERED and NOT SCORED (counts printed, no outcome). Expected before any data: with ~354 / ~651 True arms per half, H3, H4 (30-minute-high subsets split two ways) and H5 (four legs, from 10:31) will likely fall below 100 IN in half A and be UNDERPOWERED; H1 and H2 are the cells most likely to be scored.
pass: A cell PASSES only if in BOTH halves: DiD >= +5 bp with day-clustered t >= t_crit; lift_vs_random >= 0 for IN; IN mean net10 > 0; >= 100 IN arms; >= 8 days; the name-day-equal DiD > 0; and after dropping the 3 names and (separately) the 3 days with the largest share of DiD, DiD stays >= 0. H2 additionally needs OUT lift_vs_random < 0 in both halves. FAIL if DiD's day-clustered t <= -2 in either half, or if both halves are scored with MDE <= 15 bp and the pass is not met. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED.
video_setups_information: S2-S7 as defined in structure_pullback_prereg.json, restricted to arm name-days: the count of True arms in 10:30-14:30 that had a setup ENTRY in the same name with entry time t <= the start of minute m and t >= m-15. Expected IN ~0-10 per half (setups fire on < 1% of name-days in history), so V is COUNT ONLY: the script first reports, outcome-blind, how many arm name-days would need look-back bars; no SIP history fetch (10 prior sessions, prior close, prior session low) happens unless the operator approves it after seeing that count, and no V outcome is scored in this study either way. The powered test of S2 is structure_pullback (extension to 2025-11-03 pending).
information_only: every pairwise AND of H1, H3, H4 and C1 (IN mean, DiD, n) - cannot pass; the synergy question, ~6 extra looks
ADX terciles and the +DI > -DI split alone
OBV / AD NOT_AT_HIGH arms vs the control
C1 legs one at a time and leave-one-out
the same features on SIP bars
all stage-'arm' rows (refusals included) as a separate population
fills (paper BUYs) scored the same way
entry at the m+2 open (an arm is not a fill; AAL took 70 s from arm to fill on 10/15)
controls restricted to m+11 .. m+60 (no overlap with the arm's hold); the share of controls in m+1 .. m+10 is printed
the 5-minute ADX(14) where valid (>= 140 minutes of bars, so from ~11:50)
calibration: before scoring, the null walk (early_entry_honest_null.frame, 120 days x 20 names) is run with SYNTHETIC ARMS selected on the path: every minute in 10:00-15:30 where the close of bar m-1 is a 30-minute high, deduplicated one per name per 15 minutes, scored with the same features, control, DiD and t for H1-H5 in both halves. Every computed t (lift_vs_random and DiD) must satisfy |t| <= the two-sided Bonferroni bound over the number of t values computed (~3.0 for 20), else the method is fixed before any real score. This tests the later-only control on path-selected entries, which a board-everywhere null cannot.
no_retuning: ADX 14 / 25 / 20, the 30-bar confirmation window, C1's 10:31 start, 0.3% / 0.997 / 38-52 / 6-bar thresholds, EMA20/EMA50/RSI14, 10 bp cost, 10-minute hold, the window, the arm_ok population and the split are fixed. Any other threshold is a new prereg.
if_pass: provisional only: >= 10 forward sessions after 2026-10-20 at the same bar (the only truly held-out sample; these 31 days were used by earlier studies), then a result-skeptic review of the positive, before any gate or engine change (publishing signals.adx included).
if_fail: the cell is closed as an arm filter on the free feed for effects >= its printed MDE (in bp); smaller effects are not ruled out. An UNDERPOWERED cell is not evidence either way.
declared_deviations: completed-bar features at the arm minute; live fires intrabar
ADX/OBV/AD/EMA/RSI/VWAP restart at 09:30 each day; a charting platform carries them across sessions
IEX bars for features, SIP bars for the outcome (the harness markout)
C1 is one literal translation of a discretionary description; a FAIL tests these rules, not every reading of it
script: tools/studies/indicator_confirm_study.py (to be written; reuses early_entry_honest.load_days / markout / control_minute logic with the seed above). Default prints the count step; --score only after a result-skeptic READY on the script. Runs on the mini after the close.

amended: 2026-10-21, before any script or data, after result-skeptic FIX FIRST (10 items): population = arm_ok True arms (most 'arm' rows are refusals); sqrt(2) paired MDE and t_crit at df = days - 1; harness control (any RTH minute, not board minutes), one shared seed; DiD replaces raw IN - OUT; H2 graded on DiD with OUT lift < 0; IEX features primary, pre-market bars dropped; C1 from 10:31 with seeds, VWAP and the EMA20-or-VWAP rule defined; null calibration with path-selected synthetic arms; video setups count-only with fetch behind an operator OK; both day-exclusion rules. amended_2: 2026-10-21, after the script's first null run (synthetic data only; no real arm, control or count read): the calibration bar '|t| <= 1.0 for every cell' was replaced by a Bonferroni bound. Under an unbiased method each t is ~N(0,1), so all 20 within +/-1 happens ~0.05% of the time; the first null run had max |t| 1.45 with 17 of 20 inside 1.0 (85%, vs 68% expected), i.e. no sign of bias, and would have failed the old bar by chance. Also fixed: the control is a DECISION minute c in m+1 .. m+60 scored like the arm (entry at c+1, net10), so 'same net10' holds exactly.
